title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Benefits Matrix
content:
# Benefits Matrix — Marlowe & Finch Unlimited

The matrix shows, plan by plan, which delivery services a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan makes free, what it does for Same-Day Courier and for return labels, and the terms that frame each benefit use.

## Delivery services made free (fee 0.00)

| Delivery service | Unlimited Standard Monthly | Unlimited Student Annual | Unlimited Standard Annual | Unlimited Express Monthly | Unlimited Express Annual | Unlimited Next-Day Annual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | Free | Free | Free | Free | Free | Free |
| Pickup Point Delivery | Free | Free | Free | Free | Free | Free |
| Standard Ground | Free | Free | Free | Free | Free | Free |
| Expedited 2-Day | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Free | Free | Free |
| Next Business Day | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Free |
| Same-Day Courier (percentage off the fee) | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 50 percent |

## Return labels and surcharges

| Plan | Return method fee waived | Alaska and Hawaii surcharge waived |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | No | No |
| Unlimited Student Annual | No | No |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | No | No |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | Yes | No |
| Unlimited Express Annual | Yes | No |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | Yes | No |

## Terms common to every plan

| Term | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Minimum merchandise subtotal, after discounts, for the shipping benefit | 0.00 USD (no minimum) |
| Orders that receive the benefit | Orders placed while the membership is in status trial, active or cancellation pending |
| Value recorded for one benefit use | The list fee of the delivery service or return label waived |
| Refund window for a shipping fee charged on a covered order | 7 calendar days after the order's placed date |

## Footnotes

1. A free return label is the waiver of the return method fee on a return; only Unlimited Express Monthly, Unlimited Express Annual and Unlimited Next-Day Annual carry it.
2. Same-Day Courier is never free on any plan. Unlimited Next-Day Annual takes 50 percent off its fee; every other plan takes 0 percent off it.
3. No plan waives the Alaska and Hawaii surcharge.
4. Illustration (hypothetical fee): where a hypothetical Same-Day Courier fee were 18.00, 50 percent off leaves a member on Unlimited Next-Day Annual paying 9.00, while a member on any other plan pays the full 18.00.
